name: Jen Cardini (FR)
description: Jen Cardini, a French DJ, will perform at Plano B in Porto. The event starts at 23:59 and is scheduled to end at 06:00.
longDescription:
Jen Cardini, a French DJ with over 30 years of experience, is set to perform at Plano B in Porto. Known for their work as an A&R for labels Correspondant and DISCH, Cardini has helped redefine the French electronic music scene through remixes and productions. They regularly play at major festivals and clubs worldwide, including Glastonbury, Primavera Sound, Berghain, and Bassiani.

This event marks Cardini's return to Plano B, three years after their last set in December 2023. The doors open at 23:59 on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and the performance is expected to conclude at 06:00 on December 13. Tickets are priced at €10.61 and do not include any drinks. The venue is located at Rua De Cândido Dos Reis 30, 4050-151 Porto.
